messages:
support: FYI tenant `foo-app` started seeing intermittent 403s right after our scheduled API key rotation. ~5% of requests fail with `invalid_api_key`. Customer impacted in us-east-1.
kevin: can you grab a few failing request IDs + timestamps so we can trace in the proxy logs?
support: req_id=01H8X2Q9ZB ts=2026-03-16T21:12:03Z, req_id=01H8X2QACF ts=2026-03-16T21:12:19Z. All routed to edge-proxy-a-1.
emma: :eyes: quick scan of rotation job: vault path `secret/data/services/foo-app/key` was updated at 2026-03-16T20:59:40Z. Proxy logs show repeated `key_mismatch` and entries mentioning `cached_kid=abc123 new_kid=def456`.
infra-oncall: paste short log snippet from edge-proxy-a-1:
```
WARN auth: signature verification failed -> invalid_api_key, kid mismatch
DEBUG auth: cached_kid=abc123 last_checked=2026-03-15T02:11:00Z
ERROR auth: attempted refresh returned 304 not-modified
```
kevin: interesting: the proxy tried a refresh and got 304 so it assumed nothing changed.
emma: repro on staging (steps):
  1) write new key material to vault (new PEM, new kid value)
  2) rotation job triggers webhook -> vault updated
  3) proxy receives webhook -> calls keystore endpoint -> gets 200 and new payload -> works
But when rotation replaced only KMS alias (re-encrypt) and left published `kid` header changed in a different way, the keystore endpoint returned 304 due to bug in our ETag/calc and proxy didn't update local file.
dev-backend: hypothesis: our keystore endpoint computes ETag from KMS ciphertext metadata, but rotation that rewrapped with new alias can produce same ciphertext length and metadata ordering leading to identical ETag. Proxy relies solely on 304 to skip writing file.
kevin: workaround for impacted tenant: we asked customer to restart their proxy instance and confirmed errors stopped. Sent outage note and offered restart assistance. :white_check_mark:
support: customer confirmed restart cleared the 403s. They want permanent fix and RCA.
emma: planned fixes: 1) change keystore endpoint to compute ETag from sha256(full PEM content) not metadata, 2) make proxy fallback to validate signature and force refresh if signature verification fails, 3) wire rotation webhook to call `/internal/refresh-keys` on proxies after any vault write.
kevin: I'll open an incident ticket (INC-2483) and link this thread. We'll patch keystore service and push a canary to edge-proxy fleet. Also schedule a small backfill job to call refresh on proxies for last 24h rotations.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot started rollout r/edge-proxy/2026-03-17-canary -> edge-proxy-a-1 -> edge-proxy-a-2
emma: thanks all. Leaving notes in the Vault rotation runbook about forcing `/internal/refresh-keys` until patch lands. :lock:
kevin: assigning follow-ups: @emma (keystore ETag fix), @dev-backend (proxy refresh fallback), @infra-oncall (automation to call refresh webhook). ETA for patch: 24-48h.
support: closing loop with customer, will update once patch is live.
